outcome: Persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN)
cohort: The study included 329 full-term and post-term neonates diagnosed with Meconium Aspiration Syndrome (MAS) at King Salman Armed Forces Hospital in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia.
finding: Mechanical ventilation was required in 9.1% of neonates with MAS, and no significant associations were found between maternal medical history, pregnancy complications, and the need for mechanical ventilation.
mod_finding: A significant association was observed between cesarean section (CS) deliveries and the administration of surfactant therapy.
